note: The local server hung for ~8 min at the start of the run (TCP accepted, no HTTP reply; curl 000) and recovered on its own; it was not restarted. Browser cases use fresh agent-browser profiles (sessions pwa2..pwa5). Offline emulation: `agent-browser set offline on` does NOT survive a CLI `open`/`reload` (the navigation went to the network: /api/me returned 401), so every offline navigation here is an in-page location.replace() after offline was set, confirmed by a fetch log (init script) showing /api/* 'Failed to fetch'.
